judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The 'Ooooh' opener, the plain journal line and the farmhands knocked down all fit Nox's farm quests. But 'the guards will never get here in time' is filler, and the reward line 'You will need my old [Thing] more than I will, up at [Place]' is a neat setup for the next chapter that sounds more like a modern writer than Westwood's blunter thank-yous.
